scope: One global, label-independent split assignment for the three frozen TDC Veith train_val tasks. This contract authorizes split generation and train_val-only validation, not a model fit, feature result, public-test prediction, or challenge mapping.

train_val_measurements_for_post_assignme.mount_rule: Mount this one verified file, not its parent directory. Do not expose the sibling molecule, split, or prior-fold files to the summary process.

environment.role: Split generation only; no MapLight dependency enters the core environment.

population.row_policy: Preserve every official source row. Never collapse a structure-task cell or resolve a conflicting label. Group identical standardized structures together and evaluate row-level AUPRC on all retained rows.

assignment_firewall.trusted_projection_boundary: One minimal preparation process verifies the pinned source hashes, selects official train_val identities, and writes the stripped input projection. This trusted process alone may resolve the label-bearing canonical molecule source. It must not open any measurement file or parse the provenance column.
forbidden_inputs: any model prediction or feature value
assignment_firewall.assignment_process_rule: The assignment operation accepts no canonical or official split path. Its only row input is the already generated and hashed shadow_input_rows.csv.
assignment_firewall.model_facing_rule: Feature processes receive only shadow_rows.csv or a further label-absent feature projection. Input-preparation, canonical, adapter, measurement, score, and public-test roots are not mounted or resolvable.
assignment_firewall.label_summary_rule: After the label-independent shadow_rows.csv hash is frozen, a separate summary process may join only the single pinned 30,038-row train_val measurements file. It must verify the parent receipt and reject any identity absent from shadow_rows.csv before parsing a target.

input_projection_contract.immutability: The output directory must not exist before preparation and is never overwritten.

rows.row_order: task ascending, source_row ascending, molecule_id ascending
rows.raw_structure_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact raw_structure UTF-8 bytes without normalization or an added newline

required_receipts: preparation source revision and file SHA-256
all four trusted source paths and SHA-256 values
exact row, task, unique-structure, raw-form, target-column, provenance-column, and public-test counts

input_projection_contract.repeatability: Generate two independent roots from the same reviewed source and require byte-identical rows and manifests before assignment.
input_projection_contract.serialization: UTF-8, comma-delimited CSV with csv.DictWriter minimal quoting, header in the declared order, LF line terminators, and no blank lines.

global_identity.duplicate_rule: Every source row with the same standardized_structure_hash inherits one global node and identical assignments across every task.
global_identity.raw_input_rule: Grouping uses standardized structure. Exact MapLight feature parity uses each official raw Drug string. Because one standardized hash can have multiple raw strings, exact raw-row features must bind molecule_id, raw_structure_sha256, and standardized_structure_hash; they must not silently cache only by standardized hash.

scaffold.boundary_claim: Exact standardized duplicates and scaffold groups are indivisible in this protocol.

community.distance_input_order: Preallocate one contiguous one-dimensional NumPy float64 array of exact length N*(N-1)/2. For unique-structure index i from 1 through N-1, fill its next i values with 1 minus BulkTanimotoSimilarity(fingerprint[i], fingerprints[0:i]) in ascending prior index order.
community.community_hash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 community-v1 followed by a vertical bar and the member standardized_structure_hash values sorted ascending and joined by vertical bars.
community.duplicate_rule: Duplicate source rows inherit the community of their one global standardized-structure node.
community.boundary_claim: Exact standardized duplicates and complete Taylor-Butina communities are indivisible in this protocol. This is a chemistry-cluster holdout; it does not claim that every pair above the threshold is in one cluster.

resource_cap.failure_rule: If the exact preallocated float64 path and RDKit dense expansion exceed either cap, record a precise pre-model blocker. Do not switch storage dtype, algorithm, threshold, fingerprint, or ordering after inspecting labels or model results.

protocol_interpretation: Do not union scaffold and community group constraints. Scaffold groups are indivisible in the scaffold protocol; communities are indivisible in the community protocol. Unioning both systems would coarsen two intended stress tests into one different protocol.

fold_assignment.group_weight: Number of official train_val source rows across all three tasks that belong to the group.
fold_assignment.group_order: Sort by descending group weight, then SHA-256 hex of UTF-8 seed|protocol|group-order-v1|group_hash, then group_hash ascending.
fold_assignment.assignment: For each group, choose the fold minimizing the tuple (current assigned global source-row count, SHA-256 hex of UTF-8 seed|protocol|fold-tie-v1|group_hash|fold, fold). Assign the complete group once globally.
fold_assignment.inner_fold_rule: Emit the empty-string sentinel for outer fold 0. For outer folds 1 through 4, emit the mapped inner fold 0 through 3. No other empty or numeric value is valid.
fold_assignment.task_rule: Join the same global assignment unchanged to every source row and task. Never rebalance, reseed, or regroup per task.

output_contract.immutability: The output directory must not exist before generation and is never overwritten.

shadow_rows.row_order: task ascending, source_row ascending, molecule_id ascending
shadow_rows.raw_structure_sha256: Carry the verified SHA-256 of the exact raw_structure UTF-8 bytes from shadow_input_rows.csv without normalization or an added newline.
shadow_rows.serialization: UTF-8, comma-delimited CSV with csv.DictWriter minimal quoting, header in the declared order, LF line terminators, no blank lines, and an empty field for each outer-validation inner-fold sentinel.

required_receipts: implementation source revision and file SHA-256
environment lock SHA-256 and RDKit version
per-task protocol-repeat-fold row, group, positive, negative, and prevalence counts
runtime, peak RSS, fit, prediction, label-access, and evaluation counts

post_assignment_validation.validation_order: Hash shadow_rows.csv before opening the train_val measurement projection. Then validate labels without changing any assignment.
required: exactly 30,038 allowed train_val rows and zero public-test rows
every official train_val identity appears exactly once and no extra identity appears
raw and standardized structure hashes recompute exactly
one scaffold group assignment per standardized structure
one community assignment per standardized structure
no scaffold group crosses a scaffold protocol fold
no community crosses a community protocol fold
all three tasks reuse the same global node assignments
outer-fold values are complete and in 0 through 4
inner-fold values are empty exactly on outer fold 0 and otherwise equal the frozen 1-to-0 through 4-to-3 mapping
outer fold 0 and each inner validation fold contain both classes for every task, protocol, and repeat
each corresponding training population contains both classes
all duplicate and conflicting-label source rows remain present
post_assignment_validation.failure_rule: Reject the shadow freeze without reseeding, task-specific regrouping, row deletion, threshold change, or label-informed repair. Preserve a compact blocker receipt and revise the contract only through a new reviewed pre-result milestone.

nested_evaluation_policy.selection_metric: pooled inner out-of-fold average precision within one task, protocol, and repeat
nested_evaluation_policy.selection_scope: four grouped inner folds inside outer training only
nested_evaluation_policy.outer_operation: Refit the retained configuration on the complete outer training population and score outer fold 0 once.
nested_evaluation_policy.repeat_reporting: Report each of three outer AUPRC values and their arithmetic mean. Do not concatenate repeated appearances of a row and treat them as independent.
nested_evaluation_policy.nested_winner_fit_formula: When H alternatives are compared by four-fold inner OOF and exactly one retained configuration receives the outer fit, the count is 18 * S * (4 * H + 1).
nested_evaluation_policy.fixed_ablation_fit_formula: When K fixed candidates have no inner choice and each is outer-scored once, the count is 18 * K * S. Seven one-seed candidates require 126 fits. Extending one retained candidate from seed 1 to all five seeds adds 72 fits, for 198 total.
nested_evaluation_policy.all_candidates_outer_scored_formula: When H candidates each receive four inner OOF fits and an outer fit, the count is 18 * S * 5 * H. Seven one-seed candidates require 630 fits; extending one retained candidate to the other four seeds adds 72, for 702 total.
nested_evaluation_policy.pre_fit_requirement: Before any fit, a separate representation experiment contract must choose exactly one design, freeze H or K, attach one exact estimator to every feature ablation, declare seeds, and state the exact fit count. The shadow freeze authorizes none of these fits.
nested_evaluation_policy.occam_default: Prefer fixed one-seed representation ablations and reserve all five MapLight seeds for the retained exact comparator unless a pre-result contract justifies nested alternative selection.

known_rejected_reuse.current_task_specific_inner_folds: forbidden because 8,442 standardized structures and 5,537 scaffold groups receive conflicting fold IDs across tasks
